verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents a `/v2/parse` endpoint that accepts direct uploads of local files (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, "etc.") and turns them into Markdown or structured JSON, so users don't need to host the files publicly first. PowerPoint is never named explicitly; it is only implied by "and more". Missing for 10: explicit PPTX support, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality across these formats.
